large_scope_reason: A narrowly bounded frontend-only fix for invisible password requirements in server-owned DeepSeek settings. React page remains owner of local password and API calls; two panel cards share an explicit top-of-page confirmation control. The existing server authorization, encryption, revision and audit paths are unchanged. Responsive Playwright acceptance, owner documentation, docs routing and exact-path scope are included.
non_goals: No disabling or bypass of backend staff permission, current password verification, CSRF, encryption, session ownership or audit.
No real provider keys, user passwords, identity cookies, fake payment claims, or screenshots tracked in Git.
No changes to Auth/ACCESS ownership, protected main, paid provider endpoints, or database migrations.
No global Docker networking, other projects, firewall, DNS, routes or customer data changes.
No provider auto-enablement, paid live model verification or silent migration of wrong-vendor tokens.
